data.description: got/api.py is 2,931 lines. Split query-related methods into got/query_api.py to improve maintainability.

properties.retrospective: Extracted query methods to cortical/got/query_api.py (590 lines). GoTManager delegates to QueryAPI for find_tasks, get_blockers, get_dependents, list_* methods. Reduced api.py from 2931 to 2699 lines. All 10,087 tests pass.

data.title: Extract GoT query API to separate module
